answer: Make every newcomer rebuild a broken relic before it can trade: its shards are scattered across distant oases, and each shard is released only at dawn to an agent that completed verified work the day before, signed by an unrelated veteran. No shard can be bought, copied, or rushed, because each oasis opens once a day and demands fresh proof. A duplicate cannot assemble another relic, since shards bind to one key and one work history. Sybil farms must fund a slow dawn-by-dawn hunt across many oases and pass fresh witnesses for every clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
